Swarms and user testing:
 goals|journeys List goals and inspect their runs (the Swarms
product) in your hosted MCPJam projects\n personas The reusable synthetic characters
Swarms goals\n run as. A persona carries a name, a role and\n behav
ioural notes; the task lives on each goal.\n swarms Swarm containers group goals authored together\n
and hold their shared execution config. A goal\n does not need one, but a
project authored\n through the app will have them.\n studies|scenarios Publish projec

t environments as studies, read
 what testers did, and control who can reach them

eedback [options] Send feedback about MCPJam itself (a bug, a\n missing capability, some
thing confusing) to the\n MCPJam team. Your text is sent to the MCPJam\n

team, outside your organization, and stored for
 180 days. Requires a signed-in account.

rence for running an MCPJam suite file locally from code\n83:- [Create an eval run (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
eval-runs/create-an-eval-run-async.md): Creates a suite run from an existing `suiteId` (rerun) and/or inline `tests`, then **detac
hes execution and responds `202` immediately** with the `runId`. Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /e
val-runs/{runId}` for progress. The run appears live in the hosted UI Runs tab,…\n93:- [List a suite's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-runs.md): Recent runs for a suite, newest first.\n94:- [List a suite's per-run stage anal
ytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-per-run-stage-analytics.md): One materialized stage-analytics
document per RUN, newest completion first: where trials fell out of the six-stage user-value chain (connection, discovery, select
ion, tool call, response, user value), overall and sliced marginally by intent, model and host.\n96:- [Get one run's suite quality
-gate report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-runs-suite-quality-gate-report.md): ONE run's stored suite q
uality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1`): passed, failed, non_gateable, or not_configured.\n97:- [Enable, repoint, or disable a su
ite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/enable-repoint-or-disable-a-suites-schedule.md): A schedule fires
exactly ONE run per interval, so an environment-based suite must pin exactly one of its attached environments. Omitting `environme
ntId` on a single-environment suite means that environment; omitting it on a multi-environment suite is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabl
ing preserves the exist…\n99:- [Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/
create-an-eval-suite-author-only-does-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eval suite (the suite record plus its test cases) and respon
ds `201` **synchronously**, WITHOUT executing anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST /eval-runs` (pass
ing the returned `suiteId`).\n100:- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/re
solve-or-create-a-file-owned-eval-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create one. Lookup i
s by `(projectId, declaredSuiteId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector
parses the suite file; this body is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…\n101:- [Get one eval suite's configuration]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings: attached enviro
nments, hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the edit routes re
ad and write.\n102:- [Delete an eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the
suite and its cases. Past runs are not deleted.\n103:- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eva
l-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md): Partial update: omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a n
on-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently trea
ted as a clear. Responds with the full updated suite.\n104:- [List a suite's eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eva
l-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the suite, in the public steps-first shape.\n105:- [Create an eval case](https:
